race.comment: BOLD BORDEAUX (1) resumed with a narrow win at Sale over this trip, scoring by a head. He's a lightly raced 4yo who gets every hope again and will take beating in another suitable affair. YOLO (4) got the job done last start over this route with a tidy win. Little bit tougher against ones with upside now but should be right there from a good gate. GINA'S A STAR (10) is racing very well of late, notching up her second win at Sandown Hillside last time, beating Per Sempre who won on Saturday at Mornington. Right in this again. HOTSPUR REALE (11) resumes having been in strong, consistent form last campaign. Can pick up where he left off.
